headline: Energy security: Bangladesh to buy 18 LNG cargoes from France's TotalEnergies
summary: The government will import two cargoes per month from October to June to meet emergency gas demands amid geopolitical instability in the Middle East.
details: The government has approved the purchase of 18 liquefied natural gas (LNG) cargoes from the French multinational TotalEnergies. The import will be conducted through a direct purchase method, with two cargoes arriving each month over the next nine months.
caption:
To secure emergency gas supplies, Bangladesh is importing 18 LNG cargoes from France's TotalEnergies.

The government has approved the purchase of 18 liquefied natural gas (LNG) cargoes from the French multinational TotalEnergies. The import will be conducted through a direct purchase method, with two cargoes arriving each month over the next nine months.

#Bangladesh #EnergySecurity #LNG #TotalEnergies #GasImport

Source: Prothom Alo, Dhaka Tribune

headline: 27 metro rail bearing pads classified as critical, cracks in 46 piers
summary: Road Transport and Bridges Minister Shaikh Rabiul Alam reveals safety audit findings for the Uttara-Motijheel route, including 730 defective pads.
details: Road Transport and Bridges Minister Shaikh Rabiul Alam informed Parliament that 27 bearing pads on the Dhaka Metro Rail route from Uttara to Motijheel have been identified as critical, while 147 are minor.
// Out of 730 total defective bearing pads, 297 issues were primarily linked to poor workmanship during installation.
caption:
27 critical bearing pads and cracks in 46 piers: Dhaka Metro Rail's safety audit reveals worrying structural defects.

Road Transport and Bridges Minister Shaikh Rabiul Alam informed Parliament that 27 bearing pads on the Dhaka Metro Rail route from Uttara to Motijheel have been identified as critical, while 147 are minor.

// Out of 730 total defective bearing pads, 297 issues were primarily linked to poor workmanship during installation.

#DhakaMetro #SafetyAudit #Bangladesh #Infrastructure #PublicSafety

Source: Dhaka Tribune, The Daily Star
